tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Amount put to tender is Inclusive of GST. The contractor should quote the rates Including GST

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The Bidder /Company (herein after referred to as the bidder) should be Registered/Empanelled with Registered companies or competent authority
Valid Employees provident fund (EPF) registration certificate with latest paid challan
Copy of Income tax return filed for the financial year 2025-26 mentioning the pan
GST Registration certificate

To qualify for award of this contract, each Tenderer in his name should have in the last five years i.e. 2021-22, 2022-23,2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26. Satisfactorily completed (at least 90% of contract value) as a prime contractor, at least one similar work of value not less than 50% of the amount put to tender i.e. Rs 12.50 Lakhs. The work done should be obtained from a competent authority not below the rank of Executive Engineer of the concerned division and counter signed by Superintending Engineer. Note One similar work means Consultancy Services for survey, investigation, Detailed Engineering, Preparation of Designs, Drawings, Estimates, Draft Tender Documents including preparation of necessary land acquisition proposals if required, comprising assessment of flood, detailed survey and investigations, diversion scheme flood protection works and restoring the original the original boundaries of Nala/River-20 Marks

To qualify for award of this contract, each Tenderer in his name should have in the last five years i.e. 2021-22, 2022-23,2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26. Achieved in at least Two Financial years an average Financial Turnover of Rs.25.00 lakhs. All document/certificates issued by a Charted Accountant should have a UDIN (Unique Document Identification Number) generated through the ICAI (The Institude of chartered Accountants of India) Portal. Certificate without UDIN the documents uploaded will be considered and treated as invalid document.Duly giving 10% escalation every year and Income Tax returns filed for the years indicated above should be furnished-20 Marks
The Consultancy firm should have completed at least one DPRs of Flood Protection and Restoring the original width of Nalas works and got approval from State or Central Water Commission-20 Marks

The Cover-I (Technical bid) will be opened first and thereafter Cover-II (Financial bid) of only those bidders who fulfill the pre-qualification criteria and other conditions as mentioned at Para 1.1 will be opened

The Technical bids of all bidders who have up loaded the tender along with all relevant documents and produced the original documents for verification will be considered in the technical evaluation. Further the lowest bidder (L1), highest bid scorer can be determined amongst the other responsive bidders. However, prior to awarding of the work, the successful bidder (L1) would be asked to produce the original documents in support of the uploaded documents to enter into agreement. If the successful bidder does not produce the original documents and establishment of an office as stated above, for entering into a agreement, then his bid will be treated as non-responsive bid as per clause 26 (A) of the KTPP Rules. The names of the bidders who do not produce the original documents will be removed from select list of KNNL enrolment and barred from participation in any of the tenders to be invited by KNNL, apart from forfeiting the EMD, paid through e-cash

Personnel including Skills and competencies- The Bidder / Company should have and deploy the following key personnel / man power for the assignment. Bio data of individual key personnel signed by the individual member shall be furnished Total 20 Marks 1) Senior Electro-mechanical engineer- A Post Graduate in electrical / Mechanical / Environment engineering with a minimum of 10 years experience in the relevant field of design of Lift Irrigation Scheme a) 10 Years experience- 2 Marks b) 15Years experience 3- Marks c) Above 15 Years experience-4 Marks 2) Senior Total Station Specialist- A Post-Graduate in Civil Engineering/Remote Sensing with a minimum of 10 years experience in the relevant field of GIS/Total Station survey a) 10 Years experience- 2 Marks b) 15Years experience 3- Marks c) Above 15 Years experience-4 Marks. 3) Senior Water Resources Engineer- A Post Graduate in Water Resources / Hydrology Engineering with minimum of 10 years experience in the relevant field a) 10 Years experience- 1 Marks b) 15Years experience 2- Marks c) Above 15 Years experience-3 Marks 4) Senior Structural Engineer- A Post-Graduate in Structural Engineering with minimum of 10 years experience in the relevant field a) 10 Years experience- 1 Marks b) 15 Years experience 2- Marks c) Above 15 Years experience-3 Marks B) Supporting Staff 1) Electro-mechanical engineer- A Graduate in Electrical/Environment engineering with minimum of 3 years experience in the relevant field a) 3 Years experience- 1 Marks b) 5 Years experience 1.5 Marks c) Above 5 Years experience-2 Marks 2) Senior Surveyor- A Graduate in Civil Engineering with minimum of 3 years experience in operation of Total Station and GPS equipment a) 3 Years experience- 1 Marks b) 5Years experience 1.5 Marks c) Above 5 Years experience 2 Marks 3) CAD Draughtsman- A Diploma in civil engineering with minimum 3 years experience in the relevant field- a) 3 Years experience- 1 Marks b) 5Years experience 1.5 Marks c) Above 5 Years experience-2 Marks. The consent letters of key personnel / man power to be part of the above assignment should be enclosed.No enclosing of consent letters will automatically result in non-applying the Marks Total 20 Marks

Description of Methodology- The approach and methodology shall clearly define the Consultants approach to complete the assignment within the time frame-10 Marks a) Fair-5 Marks b) Good-7 Marks c) 10 Marks

Technical Requirements-The bidder should have the following survey equipment / Licensed software for carrying out the assignment. 1) The Differential Global Positioning System (DGPS) (Static and RTK) having angular Least count of 1 Inch and accuracy of 5 Inch both for Hz and Vz distance measurement accuracy of 1mm plus 1.5mm, with all the necessary accessories. 2)The Electronic Total Station having angular least count of 1 Inch and accuracy of 5 Inch both for Hz and Vz distance measurement accuracy of 1mm plus 1.5mm, with all the necessary accessories. 3)Autocad LT 2009 or above Autocad 2009 or above, Auto Plotter 8 with CanSE module. 4) All necessary vehicles for carrying out the survey work. 5) Irricad or equivalent software for design of lift scheme, pressure and Gravity distribution system. 6)STAAD Pro Software of latest version. The intending bidder should have availability of above equipment/software either owned or by procurement against self-mobilization or by lease agreement entered into before the date of filling the tender-10 Marks

Minimum technical score A proposal scoring minimum technical score of 75 out of possible score of 100 will be deemed to be technically responsive. Others will be rejected and their financial bids will not be opened

Opening of financial proposals Financial Proposals of all the technically responsive bids will be opened and evaluated. Combined evaluation of technical and financial proposals will be carried out in the following manner

Combined total score equall (TS X 0.75) plus (LP/FP) X100X0.25 (Where TS equall to Technical score, LP is the Lowest price among the financial proposal and FP is the price offered by the consultant being evaluated.)The consultant obtaining the highest combined score will be invited for negotiation before awarding the work to the consultant

Issue and submission of e-tender documents a) All the consultants will have to compulsorily give an email ID which shall be considered as primary means of communication. Any communication sent by email from KNNL E.E.s email ID (eemrbcc3byt at gmail.com) shall be considered as final. Tenders and other verifications will also be uploaded on the website
The intending bidders are advised to visit the site of work before submission of the tenders

Within 20 days of receipt of the Letter of Acceptance, the successful Tenderer shall deliver to the Employer a Security deposit in any of the forms given below for an amount equivalent to 5% of the Contract price plus full difference amount for below quoted tenders as additional security (for unbalanced tenders) The additional performance security will be released proportionately to the bill amount till the contractor achieves progress of the entire cost of the work as per the agreement

The necessary certificates / documents in support of eligibility criteria fulfilled as stipulated shall be scanned and attached to e-tender document. The Original certificates/documents shall be produced on or before stipulated date and time for verification. Scanned signature of the bidder/authorized representative of the bidder shall be attached while uploading bid document
If any of the dates mentioned above happen to be a general holiday, the next working day holds good

The Pre-qualification bid will be opened first and there after the financial bids of those prequalified will be assessed on payment of tenders processing fee. The financial bid will be opened subjected to the conditions that Electronic EMD payment is confirmed in the E-tender portal
Conditional tenders are liable to be rejected. The officer competent to accept the tender shall have the right to reject any or all the tenders without assigning any reason whatsoever
Corrigendum will be published in web site for all modifications/corrections if any

The intending bidders should note that, if any of lands either in part/parts or whole required for the work is not acquired by the Nigam, it shall be the responsibility of the bidder to take possession of such land and start the work by the consent of the land owners before commencement of work at no extra cost to the Nigam and no claim whatsoever relating to non availability of land would be entertained
The contractor should mention their recent correct postal address and e-mail address in the declaration form
Incomplete tender documents will be rejected

All materials like steel, cement etc., required for the above work should be procured by the contractor only at his own cost. And these materials will have to be got tested by the competent authority before put to use
The contractors shall send the authorization letter for their representatives duly attesting their signature
As per the Karnataka building and other construction workers welfare cess act 1996, 1% of the bill amount will be deducted from the bills
Tenders will be opened on the due date in presence of the contractor or their Authorized representatives

As per KTPP Act 2018 (Jan 21st 2019) rule 14a i.e Debarment of tenderers: The procurement entity may debar tenderer for a period not exceeding 3 years from participation in its tenders following such procedures as may be prescribed on the ground that tenderer is engaged in corrupt or fraudulent practices in competing or executing the contract including misleading the procuring entity or any stage of procurement activity with a fraudulent intention. Action can be taken accordingly
The payment of bills of this work will be made as and when the letter of credit is received under the same head of account from KNNL/Government of Karnataka
The contractors should adhere to the accepted action plan submitted by him under any circumstances without linking to the pending bill payment of the work
Typo-graphical errors if any will not be the ground for any claims by the Contractor
Tendering by the joint venture will not be allowed
The contractor should furnish the name of the individual /firm with address and Telephone numbers with place of registration, year of incorporation etc
The tender processing charges paid by the bidders are not refundable even if the tenders are cancelled
Royalty on construction materials and other taxes will be deducted as per prevailing Government orders

The tenderer has to make his own arrangement for procurement of all materials required for the work. There is no departmental supply of materials. Contractor should procure only ISI mark materials and submit necessary quality control certificates from the authorized quality control authority, before execution
Sub leasing of work in any form is prohibited

No quarries are approved by KNNL for materials. The quarries considered are for the estimate purpose only. The intending bidders shall visit the site, identify the quarries, ascertain availability for the quantity and quality of the materials required for the work and shall quote his rates accordingly. No extra claim whatsoever will be entertained in this regard

The rates includes all leads and lifts and work shall be carried out as per the instruction of Engineer-in-charge .All specifications are as per relevant IS codes in vogue and Indian Road Congress. The rates for the specification in the Schedule B includes all lead and lifts irrespective of the distance and height, no extra claim will be entertained for additional lead and lifts
The validity period of EMD shall be for a minimum period of 225 days from the date of opening of the tenders
The EMD of the unsuccessful bidder will be refunded only after the acceptance of the tender by the competent authority as per tender clause
The tender inviting authority has got right either accepting tender or rejecting the tender without assigning any reasons

In case of death of contractor after executing the agreement commencement of the work , his legal heir if any eligible registered contractor and willing can execute and complete the work at the accepted tender rates irrespective of the cost of the work
EMD amount and Amount put to tender will be as mentioned in the e-portal of respective work
